name: Shichinohe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shichinohe town emblem in navy, orange and green: a navy stylised human figure with raised arms, an orange disc and a green disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shichinohe, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 8 September 2005.

features.role: Shichinohe town emblem — a navy stylised human figure with raised arms, an orange disc and a green disc
